_readme: Drop-in for src/renderer/data/events/cat-presence-v0.1.json at 3e51292. Same 10 keys, {name} only (fillTokens), no pronouns, no numbers. Condensed from presence-beats-v1.json to one string per key, since there's no trait or activity gate.

presence.watch.sighting.text: From up here the land lies open below you, and after a while something moves in it. A cat. You know that shape: {name}.

presence.watch.doing.home.text: {name} is at ease on familiar ground, nosing along the edge of the land and stopping now and then to leave a mark on a stone. {name} hasn't seen you. Not yet.

presence.watch.doing.near.text: {name} is crossing the hillside below at a steady pace, head low, going somewhere with purpose. {name} hasn't seen you. Not yet.

presence.stone.wind_scree.text: A stone clatters down the scree, then another. Not the wind. Something heavy shifted its weight up there, and a head appears over the rocks, ears pricked. It's {name}, as caught off guard as you are.

presence.stone.east_saddle.text: Grit trickles down from the saddle above you, and a loose rock tumbles past. A head lifts over the ridgeline, ears pricked. It's {name}, as caught off guard as you are.

presence.hunt.open.text: You've barely started eating when the back of your neck prickles. Someone has smelled the blood. {name} stands a few lengths off, nose working, eyes on your kill.

presence.hunt.trespass.text: You've barely started eating when {name} steps out of the cover, eyes on your kill. "That was taken on our ground," {name} says, low and flat. "You know that, don't you?"

presence.hunt.warn.text: You hunch over your kill and let a growl roll out of your chest. {name} backs off, slowly, and doesn't look away once.

presence.hunt.let_watch.text: You go on eating. {name} stays put and watches every bite, until there's nothing left but bones. Then {name} stands, gives you one long look you can't read, and pads away without a word.

presence.spar.locked.text: {name} doesn't know you well enough to wrestle with you yet.
